answer: Problem: sybil farms mint quiet wallets that only wake at the nadir of an epoch to snatch grading seats. Mechanism: before any seat opens, each identity must grow a vine of peer-stamped micro-proofs whose invite distance crosses a non-kin reef. Cost: stretching that vine burns wall-clock and referral separation, not bare keypair spam. Verification: panels rebuild the vine from stamped challenge digests alone and reject kin-clique reefs. Failure: if the vine never clears the reef before the nadir window closes, stamps expire and seats stay shut.
